en.provider.softInterruptDescription: After Codex force-interrupts with ESC (Steer does not count), it adds a runtime abort notice to the next request. Some Chat Providers treat the resulting middle system message as a new prefix and lose the earlier input-cache hit. When enabled, Rosetta sends the exact Codex abort notice as a separate user-role <codex_runtime_notice> with explicit non-user attribution. The upstream stream is still cancelled normally; Rosetta does not retain or replay hidden output, and final usage for the cancelled request may be unavailable. Provider caching remains best-effort.
en.provider.forceRosettaCompactionDescripti: For Codex compaction triggers, Rosetta sends a no-tools prompt-summary request instead of native Remote Compaction V2. The replacement mapping stores summary plaintext in SQLite for seven days. Do not enable this option unless local SQLite persistence and its filesystem protections are available.
